title: Pure Artmage
summary: Artmage cards plus the Medius the Pure and Theorealize package that every Artmage Fusion requires, with generic staples. Artmages span different Monster Types and unlock upgraded board-wide effects once you control three or more different Monster Types.

summary.title: Starters
points: Artmage Academic Arcane Arts Acropolis (Field Spell) grants an extra Normal Summon for Medius the Pure and discards a Spell/Trap to search any Artmage monster (locking you into Artmage, Medius the Pure and Extra Deck summons that turn).
Medius the Pure adds or Special Summons Artmage Power Patron from the Deck on Normal or Special Summon, and revives itself from the GY by shuffling a monster from your hand or field into the Deck.
Theorealize Past Lull Special Summons Medius the Pure from the hand or Deck while you control an Artmage card, and prevents the opponent from responding to that effect.

summary.title: Opening: Acropolis or Medius the Pure
steps: Activate Artmage Academic Arcane Arts Acropolis, discard a Spell/Trap (such as Artmage Movement -Pedigree- or Artmage Peripeteia -Turmoil-, which recover an Artmage Trap or Spell when discarded), and search Artmage Graflare or Litera.
Normal Summon Medius the Pure (using Acropolis's extra Normal Summon) to Special Summon Artmage Power Patron from the Deck.

Special Summon Theorealized Medius from the hand while a Power Patron is on the field to search a Theorealize Spell, plus Special Summon Graflare (to Set an Artmage Spell from the Deck) and Litera (to recover an Artmage card from the GY).
Use Artmage Power Patron's Quick Effect to Fusion Summon Artmage Non-Finito or Artmage Diactorus, triggering Artmage Power Patron in the GY to search Artmage Impasto -Recapture-.

summary.title: Three Monster Types & Theorealized Medius
summary.text: With three or more different Monster Types on your field—easy to assemble across Fairy (Medius/Finmel), Dragon (Graflare), Spellcaster (Litera), Beast (Nervedo) and Fiend (Diactorus)—Artmage Diactorus gains an omni-negate for on-field activations, Artmage Finmel negates and halves all opposing monsters' ATK, and Artmage Impasto -Recapture- bounces all opposing Spells/Traps. When Impasto banishes your Fusion Monster until the End Phase as its cost, Theorealized Medius triggers on the face-up banish to transform itself into a second Artmage Diactorus from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Fusion Bosses & Locks
points: Artmage Diactorus (Medius the Pure + 1 Artmage) changes a monster's battle position as a Quick Effect, negates an on-field activation while you control 3+ Monster Types, and revives Medius the Pure when destroyed.
Artmage Non-Finito (2 Artmages) Sets an Artmage Spell/Trap from the Deck on Fusion Summon and Fusion Summons during the opponent's turn.
Nerva the Power Patron of Creation (3 Artmages, or cheated out via Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron) rewrites an Artmage monster effect activation into destroying all cards the opponent controls.
While Artmage Power Patron is face-up on the field, you can only Special Summon Fusion Monsters from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Ars Magna engine and generic Power Patron Link climb from the page's hybrid lines are omitted here to keep the focus on pure Artmage Fusion control.

allow.Medius the Pure: Named by Artmage Diactorus and the Field Spell: the Artmage Fusions can't be made without it.
allow.Theorealized Medius: Newest Medius support: it Special Summons off Artmage Power Patron and becomes Artmage Diactorus.
allow.Theorealize: Medius support: puts Medius the Pure in the GY for its revival.
allow.Theorealize Past Lull: Medius support that summons Medius the Pure off an Artmage card.
allow.Theorealize Liberation: Medius support that fetches Artmage Power Patron (300 ATK/200 DEF).
allow.Nerva the Power Patron of Creation: Fusion of three Artmage monsters, named by Artmage Power Patron.

main: Medius the Pure
Summoned: adds or summons a Power Patron monster (Artmage Power Patron) from the Deck; from the GY, shuffles a monster into the Deck to revive itself.
Artmage Power Patron
Quick Effect Fusion Summon of an Artmage Fusion or Nerva using itself; sent to the GY, searches an Artmage Spell/Trap. While it's out, only Fusions from the Extra Deck.
Artmage Graflare
Special Summons itself while you control an Artmage card and Sets an Artmage Spell from the Deck; destroys a Spell/Trap.
Artmage Litera
Special Summons itself while you control an Artmage card and gets an Artmage card back from the GY; on the opponent's Main Phase, swaps itself for another Artmage.
Artmage Finmel
Special Summons itself and draws; with three Monster Types on your field, negates and halves every opposing monster.
Theorealized Medius

Newest support, the page's spotlight. Special Summons itself while a Power Patron card is out and searches a Theorealize card; when a monster is banished face-up, becomes Artmage Diactorus from the Extra Deck.
Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron
Counts as an Artmage: banishes the top three cards to bring out Nerva as a Fusion Summon; face-up in the Extra Deck, summons an Artmage from the Deck.
Artmage Academic Arcane Arts Acropolis
Field Spell: an extra Normal Summon for Medius the Pure, and discards a Spell/Trap to search any Artmage monster (then only Artmage, Medius the Pure or Extra Deck summons that turn).
Artmage Movement -Pedigree-
If the opponent controls more monsters, summons an Artmage from the Deck; discarded for the Field Spell, gets back an Artmage Trap.
Theorealize Past Lull
With an Artmage card out, summons Medius the Pure from the hand or Deck and the opponent can't respond; from the GY, revives a Fusion next to a Link.
Theorealize Liberation
With Medius the Pure out, adds or summons Artmage Power Patron from the Deck.
Theorealize
Sends Medius the Pure from the Deck to the GY for its revival; from the GY, changes a monster's Type and Attribute to reach three Types.
Artmage Impasto -Recapture-
Counter Trap: banishes your Fusion until the End Phase to negate and destroy a monster effect; with three Types, bounces their Spells/Traps.
Artmage Peripeteia -Turmoil-
Returns an Artmage to the hand or Extra Deck to take a monster from the opponent's GY; discarded for the Field Spell, gets back an Artmage Spell.
extra: Medius the Pure + an Artmage: changes a battle position, and with three Types negates on-field activations; destroyed, brings Medius back.
Fusion of two Artmages: Sets an Artmage Spell/Trap from the Deck, and Fusion Summons on the opponent's turn.
Nerva the Power Patron of Creation
Fusion of three Artmages: turns an Artmage monster effect into destroying everything the opponent controls.
